_about: Bluetooth reset steps for Godox models, keyed by radio id, copied in plain words from Godox's own manuals. A model with no entry here shows a generic line, never invented steps. Each entry names its source. A model file's own reset_steps wins over this table.

reset_steps: Press and hold the Bluetooth button for about 2 seconds.
Let go when the Bluetooth icon on the screen starts to flash. It then stays lit: the light is reset.
0021.reset_source: Godox LA150D and LA200D instruction manual, 'Bluetooth reset function' (Godox Light app section), read 18 Oct 2026 as reproduced at manuals.plus/godox/la150d-daylight-led-light-manual and device.report/manual/2718673. The LA150Bi, LA200Bi and these share one Godox product page (godox.com Continuous Lighting Catalogue, LITEMONS LA150D/LA150Bi/LA200D/LA200Bi).
